newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - Feb 25.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe calls on French citizens to oppose racism and intolerance.
-- France posts record trade surplus for 1996 at 122.3 billion francs.

-- Reseau Ferre de France, a new structure created by a February 13, 1997 law, will operate railway infrastructure and take charge of the part of its debt linked with infrastructure costs. It seeks to lead SNCF toward better strategic decisions, with the aim of breaking even in 1998.
-- Sanofi posts 1996 profit up 11 percent at 1.743 billion francs.
-- Pollster Sofres to buy U.S. marketing research firm Intersearch Corporation.
